scope: This native-only Chrome tab's actual hidden→visible event interval, zero frame-count increase between the app's suspend-after/wake-before markers, automatic audio stop and no audio restart. This is distinct from source/VM simulation and does not retroactively change v6's frame NOT_RUN.

environment.claim_limit: Current desktop Chrome only, not every browser/GPU/physical phone.

cleanup.closure_verification: Closed only the bound task-created Sound tab. A browser tab inventory readback confirmed that exact tab ID absent, with19 other tabs remaining. It had been the sole tab in the task-created test window after closing the created blank.
cleanup.native_cleanup_limit: A final native App AX read reported the Mac locked. No unlock/bypass was attempted. The authorized owned-tab close and inventory readback used the existing browser API; no user tab/window was closed or altered by that cleanup.

limits: Event markers are app-exposed diagnostics from a real native tab-leave/return, as supplied by the frozen instrument. This reviewer did not independently audit their implementation/source timing; the orchestrator's separate code review covers suspend-after/wake-before semantics.

No page DOM was read until after native leave/return and stopped-state confirmation. Binding after the return can affect future focus/visibility behavior, so only the already-recorded two events are used for the hidden interval claim.
Audio stop/no restart is established by native playback control/status and event playing=false, not a physical audio-output recording.
The record certifies this observed interval, not universal background throttling behavior or performance.
evidence_retention: Native AX step outputs and complete DOM event array are retained in the CUA transcript and serialized here. No local screenshot/video artifact is claimed.
public_export_note: Sanitized audit copy. Local user/project/temp paths normalized; inline harness implementation omitted. Outcomes, old failures and untested conditions preserved; original evidence digest binds the private source.
